title: Marketing Designer
description:
About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission:

Our marketing team ships at a high cadence across paid, email, events, organic social, and web. In 2026 we built the strategic creative direction. In 2027 we need production horsepower—designers who turn that direction into volume, fast, using AI as leverage. The ideal candidate is a builder first and foremost, not an abstract strategist. This role reports to AfterShip’s Manager of Creative.

What You’ll Do:

  • Performance marketing ad creative (static + simple motion) for paid channels.
  • UI snippets that showcase our product benefits, used across channels.
  • Demand gen campaign creative including campaign identity + asset development.
  • Web asset development + templated wireframes leveraging our core design system.
  • Other assets as needed: organic social assets, email marketing assets, IRL event graphics.
  • Contributing to the build out of AI-native production workflows — pushing Claude Design, Midjourney, Runway, Figma AI, and whatever’s next to the limit.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Taste: Your portfolio shows you know what great B2B tech marketing design looks like.
  • AI as a reflex: You build your own agents and default to AI-native production methods every day — not as a demo you rolled out once. You are deeply curious and constantly seek out new ways to get leverage out of AI tooling.
  • Hustle: You ship fast. You care about getting to prod. You see the value in creative testing and iteration vs. aiming for polished perfection.
  • Design chops: Strong graphic design + fluency in simple motion design. Figma is your home.
  • Extreme ownership: When a project is assigned to you, you own it from beginning to end. You clear blockers and problem solve as needed to deliver on the assignment.
  • Opinionated: You always bring a POV to your work, and can articulate the rationale behind the creative choices you make.

At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Why You Should Join Us:

  • Great Place to Work Certified: We’ve been recognized for our inclusive, values-driven culture that celebrates diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovative & Inclusive Culture: Started by our software engineer-turned-CEO, AfterShip is built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We’re a passionate, global team of problem solvers who put egos aside to innovate together. We take immense pride in fostering a culture that’s inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.
  • Ambitious Mission with Real Impact: Join us in transforming eCommerce by making buying and selling easier for everyone. It’s one of the most dynamic spaces in tech, with limitless opportunities to innovate and grow.
  • Thrive & Grow: There’s no ceiling to what you can achieve or learn here. We’re committed to empowering your career while advancing together as a company.
  • Flexible Work Setup: We’re a remote-first team, meaning by default that employees work from home or on a hybrid-flexible basis in our hub locations. You’re empowered to choose a work setup that works best for you and your team. With flexible hours depending on your time zone, you’ll be able to have a schedule that fits your working style and the requirements of your role.

Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Hybrid-flexible work setups
  • Healthcare coverage offered from day 1
  • Retirement plans including company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Annual learning & wellness benefit
  • Monthly book perk
  • Career progression & professional development
  • In-office lunch and commuter benefits for those located in our hub locations

Salary range for this role: CAD$65,000 - $125,000

We are an equal opportunity employer and provide accommodations upon request throughout the recruitment process, in accordance with local legislation. Please let us know if you require any support, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs.

We believe in hiring right over hiring fast. While timelines may vary, we’re looking to fill this role as soon as possible.

Our hiring process uses AI to help with initial resume screening and to support interview note-taking. These tools help our team stay organized and fair, but all hiring decisions are made by people.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

title: Front End Developer
description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Financial Analyst (d/w/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

As Financial Analyst, Planning & Reporting Systems, you will build and maintain our planning and reporting models and dashboards, make sure data flows correctly from our source systems, and ensure the numbers the business relies on are accurate and consistent.

Alongside this, you will support core FP&A work such as forecasting, variance analysis and month-end reporting. The role reports to the Senior Director of FP&A and works closely with FinOps, Data and business stakeholders.


Your responsibilities

  • Build and maintain models in our planning platform, including dimensions, hierarchies and mapping tables, in line with the agreed model design

  • Build product P&Ls and product dashboards, and prepare the monthly reviews with commercial product owners

  • Monitor data flows from our ERP, HR and other source systems into the planning platform, and resolve issues together with FinOps and Data

  • Run monthly reconciliations between the planning platform, the general ledger and reported figures, and document the checks

  • Support the transition of planning and reporting workflows into the planning platform, in close collaboration with the FP&A team

  • Support FinOps on the interface between planning and consolidation, so management and statutory views reconcile

  • Maintain access rights, version control and model documentation

  • Support and train budget owners in using the platform for their planning and reporting

  • Automate recurring reports and workflows, using AI tools where they remove manual work

  • Support core FP&A processes when needed: monthly reporting, forecast updates, variance analysis and management materials

  • Deliver ad-hoc analysis on product performance to support commercial decisions

Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling, finance systems or a similar analytical finance role, ideally in a fast-growing or subscription-based business; alternatively, a background as implementation consultant for Pigment, Anaplan or similar planning tools

  • Hands-on experience building models or reports in a modern planning tool (e.g. Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive); Pigment experience is highly valued

  • Solid understanding of financial statements and accounting principles, with hands-on experience in budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis

  • Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of SQL; experience with ERP, consolidation or BI tools (e.g. NetSuite, LucaNet, Looker) is a plus

  • High attention to detail and care for data quality: you notice when a number does not tie, and you find out why

  • Hands-on use of AI in finance work (e.g. LLM assistants, AI features in finance and planning tools), and the curiosity to adopt new tools as they mature

  • Clear communicator, able to explain numbers to non-finance stakeholders

  • Structured, independent and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

Unser Angebot an dich:

  • Wertschätzung & Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe

  • 12 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr

  • Fachlicher Austausch & Wissenstransfer: 14 interne Communities & Netzwerke (z. B. ML, Green IT, UX, IoT)

  • Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice-Anteil

  • Jobrad, Workation, Sabbatical, Kinderbetreuungszuschuss, Gesundheitsprogramme und vieles mehr

  • Faires Gehaltsmodell: Finale Vergütung richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikation und bisherigen Erfahrung

Das ist Accso:​

Accso ist Digitalpartner für anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen nach Maß – mit AI Native Mindset. Wir verbinden exzellentes Engineering und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit pragmatischem KI-Einsatz, von der Konzeption über die Entwicklung bis hin zum Betrieb. Uns treibt eine klare Vision: die Welt ein Stück besser machen, indem wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden zukunftssichere Softwareentwicklung und messbaren Impact schaffen. Dabei steht der Mensch im Fokus – bei unseren Kunden genauso wie in unseren Teams. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, lösungsorientiert, exzellenzgetrieben, mit offener Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. In interdisziplinären Teams bringst du dich direkt beim Kunden ein – mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, aktivem Wissenstransfer und einer Kultur, die Neugier, Verantwortung und Lernen fördert. title: Product Engineer, Shop
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Rust Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Rust Engineer

Location: Berlin and surrounding

At Deepslate, we are building Speech to Speech Voice AI models that sound and act indistinguishably from a human. And we believe everyone should be able to use them.

With its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies, voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate.

Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as a major German VC fund, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners, our model is built to work wherever it is needed.

Your Role

Many core parts of our model stack are written in Rust. At the heart of it is our inference engine, written entirely in Rust.

Your mission is to build and improve these systems. You will work on the inference engine, take ownership of other Rust projects, and help decide how everything fits together. We need someone who enjoys writing good Rust code and can design software that stays understandable and maintainable as it grows.

Our models need to respond in real time. The software you build will directly influence how fast and reliable they are in an actual conversation.

What You'll Do

  • Build in Rust: Develop our inference engine and other core components of the model stack. Take projects from the first architectural decisions to running in production.

  • Design the Architecture: Decide how components and services communicate, where responsibilities belong, and how we can extend the system without making it harder to work on.

  • Work on Real-Time Systems: Build async Rust systems that handle concurrent workloads and streaming audio with low latency.

  • Improve Performance: Find bottlenecks, understand what's causing them, and improve latency, throughput, and resource usage.

  • Write Production-Ready Code: Build software that we can test, debug, and operate reliably. Help improve our tooling, documentation, and development practices along the way.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves

  • Strong hands-on experience with Rust, including ownership, borrowing, composition, and idiomatic Rust design patterns.

  • Solid experience with async Rust. You know how to structure concurrent applications and deal with synchronization, cancellation, and backpressure.

  • Experience building and working with microservice architectures.

  • A true startup mindset: You are comfortable navigating the glorious chaos of an early-stage codebase. Inconsistent structures, missing docs. You name it, you'll help fix it.

  • Drive and Vision: You aren't just looking to blindly process Jira tickets. You want to actively shape the product, architect solutions, and take complete project ownership.

Ideally, You Also Bring

  • Knowledge of actor systems and experience using actors to structure concurrent applications.

  • Experience with real-time systems, whether in embedded environments or the cloud. Both are relevant to us.

  • Experience with C/C++ interoperability, including generating Rust bindings with bindgen.

  • German, spoken and written.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with CUDA or GPU computing.

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

  • Python knowledge.

  • Experience with lower-level performance engineering, such as debugging memory leaks or understanding performance at the machine instruction level.

What We Offer

  • Technical Ownership: Our Rust stack is central to the company. You'll have the trust and freedom to make architectural decisions and see them through.

  • True R&D Freedom: We give you the time, resources, and trust to research and build technology that simply doesn't exist yet. There are difficult problems here, and room to try different approaches.

  • Competitive Compensation: We are well-funded by top-tier VCs. We offer a highly competitive salary. We are looking for top talent, and we are ready to pay for it.

  • Serious Compute: You will have access to the hardware and cloud infrastructure necessary to build, test, and optimize the systems running our models.

Deepslate is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, disability, age, or sexual orientation.

Compensation: €75K – €120K • Offers Equity

title: Research Scientist, Causal Inference
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

Causal Inference Highlights

  • A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

  • Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

  • Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

The Opportunity

As a Research Scientist at Relay, you'll:

  • Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

  • Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

  • Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

  • Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

  • Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

  • Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

  • Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

  • Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

Our Operations team is hiring an Onboarding Documents Associate to support and maintain the quality of our onboarding processes for healthcare professionals joining our platform. This is a detail-oriented individual contributor role focused on reviewing and validating onboarding documentation. You’ll play a key role in ensuring professionals can get to work quickly while meeting compliance standards across facilities and regulatory requirements.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to execute against defined workflows, manage document queues, and improve internal processes, ensuring our onboarding systems remain accurate, efficient, and scalable.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and validate onboarding documents submitted by professionals, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with facility, local, state, and federal guidelines

  • Monitor and manage queues for document submissions, backlogs, and expirations during assigned shifts, acting on real-time prioritization

  • Own and execute daily tasks including document status updates, document mapping, resolving unread submissions, and supporting special projects

  • Contribute to ongoing improvements by reviewing internal policies and recommending updates that enhance clarity and efficiency

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve document-related inquiries and improve internal workflows

  • Communicate clearly via Slack and other internal tools to ensure alignment and resolution of issues

  • Stay informed on evolving documentation standards and product updates to ensure consistent, accurate decision-making

  • Meet targets for document review time, accuracy, and throughput, contributing to both individual and team performance goals

What We’re Looking For

Detail Orientation – You have a sharp eye for detail and can identify inconsistencies or missing information quickly and accurately.

Decision Making – You’re confident making timely decisions, even in ambiguous situations, while maintaining high standards for accuracy and compliance.

Organization & Execution – You manage multiple tasks and queues effectively, maintaining consistency and reliability in a fast-paced environment.

Communication – You communicate clearly and concisely, especially when explaining decisions or collaborating across teams.

Ownership Mindset – You take responsibility for your work, follow through on tasks, and contribute to improving processes over time.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in document verification, credentialing, compliance operations, administrative support, or customer service

  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare documentation (e.g., licenses, certifications, immunization records)

  • Experience with QA or quality-focused roles

  • Familiarity with tools like Slack, Zendesk, Google Sheets, and task management platforms

Hiring Process

  • Application

  • Assessment (sent via email within 1–2 days; please check your spam folder)

  • Interview with a member of our recruiting team

  • Final interviews and offer

Technical & Workspace Requirements

Candidates are expected to have:

  • Residence within the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

  • A wired internet connection with a minimum download speed of 15 Mbps.

  • A computer meeting the following minimum specifications:

    • Intel Core i5 (8th Generation or newer)

    • AMD Ryzen 5 (2000 Series or newer)

    • Apple M1 or newer

    • Minimum 12 GB RAM (16 GB recommended)

  • A quiet and professional home workspace.

  • A noise-canceling headset.

  • Reliable internet connectivity and backup power or internet whenever possible.

Important

  • This role requires the completion of an assessment built from synthetic (not real-world) data. Please check your inbox and spam folder regularly: you will get the email within 1–2 days after applying.

  • Clipboard operates 24/7. Team members work 5 days within a 7-day schedule, including both Saturday and Sunday availability. Shifts are assigned based on business needs.

  • Each candidate's compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

  • Do not take interviews via a mobile phone.

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Strategic Account Executive for Singapore, you will own and grow GitLab’s enterprise relationships in the Singapore market. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by leading the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through rollout and long-term adoption. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager or Regional Director, you’ll use a consultative approach to understand complex customer needs, guide them through evaluation, and coordinate pre- and post-sales resources to ensure successful deployments and visible business outcomes.

You’ll work under minimal supervision on complex deals, act as the voice of the customer into GitLab, and partner closely with our strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities and develop new customers. In your first year, you’ll be expected to establish and execute clear account plans for enterprise prospects and customers in the Singapore market, build strong internal and external stakeholder relationships, and consistently manage your forecast and pipeline with transparency and discipline.

What you’ll do

  • Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in the Singapore Market, owning the full sales cycle for large and enterprise accounts
  • Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals
  • Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers
  • Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products
  • Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels
  • Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers.
  • Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management
  • Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion
  • Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes
  • Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams
  • Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly

About the team

The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Singapore market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Overview

📍 Fully Remote - Philippines & Other APAC Regions

Ready to grow beyond traditional customer support? Clipboard is hiring Worker Operations Customer Experience Specialists to support more than 400,000+ professionals using our platform. You’ll solve real-time issues across chat, voice, and email while building deep operational experience in a fast-moving environment.

We’re looking for proactive problem-solvers who communicate clearly, think critically, and stay composed under pressure. Many of our leaders started in this role, and we’re committed to growing talent from within. You can learn more about our operations team on our candidate hub.

Hiring Process

  • Application Review + Skills Assessment

Important Note: Clipboard operates 24/7. Team members work 5 days within a 7-day schedule, including both Saturday and Sunday availability. Shifts are assigned based on business needs.

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Role

We're seeking a commercially minded Commercial Counsel based in Europe to work closely with and support our General Counsel, who is based in the New York City area. You'll help manage sophisticated international commercial transactions with leading global banks, financial institutions, and other multinational companies, advise internal business teams, and support the development of our legal operations and AI capabilities. This is a hands-on role requiring strong commercial judgment, technical understanding, and the ability to navigate complex legal and regulatory requirements across jurisdictions worldwide.

Where You’ll Work

This is a 100% remote role open to candidates based in Europe.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex SaaS, partnership, and other commercial agreements, including DPAs, DORA Addenda, information security exhibits, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory and outsourcing addenda.

  • Support the General Counsel in managing international commercial negotiations, while independently handling assigned contracts and projects.

  • Implement AI-powered legal tools, improve contracting workflows, and drive legal operations and process improvements.

  • Work with Security, Engineering, and other technical teams to ensure contractual commitments accurately reflect Notabene's technology, security controls, and operational practices.

  • Advise Sales, Customer Success, and other teams on commercial legal matters and prepare the agreements, templates, and other documents they need.

What You’ll Need

  • Native-level or fully fluent written and spoken English, with a track record of independently drafting and negotiating complex legal documentation in English.

  • Fully qualified lawyer in an EU jurisdiction with 3–5 years of post-qualification experience, ideally gained within top-tier law firms, fast-growing tech environments, or a mix of both.

  • Extensive experience driving end-to-end negotiations for complex enterprise technology agreements, particularly with highly regulated or global corporate clients.

  • Strong foundation in European regulatory frameworks relevant to tech companies, including data protection, privacy, and sector-specific operational/outsourcing requirements, along with the ability to adapt to international regulatory regimes.

  • A commercially minded approach to risk management - able to balance business growth with legal exposure, articulate clear risks to stakeholders, and discern strict legal/regulatory imperatives from negotiable commercial points.

  • Ability to deliver rapid turnarounds in a fast-moving startup environment, with the willingness to work flexibly across international time zones.

title: Teach English From Home !
description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

Contract End Date / Length: 30 November 2026 (expected to be extended)
Rate: £623–£674
Languages: English; Spanish preferred

Our client is looking for a Mainframe Datacom Engineer to provide hands-on BAU support and technical ownership of an existing CA Datacom environment on IBM z/OS. The role runs alongside a wider modernisation programme and focuses on maintaining and supporting the current Datacom estate, rather than production monitoring or a Datacom-to-DB2 migration.

What you will do:

  • Administer and maintain Broadcom Datacom databases on z/OS.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve Datacom database issues independently.
  • Carry out backup, restore and recovery, and database administration and structuring.
  • Diagnose and resolve database and query performance issues.
  • Perform and support Datacom fixes, patching, patch validation and maintenance.
  • Provide Datacom technical consultancy and support to applications and users.
  • Carry out root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
  • Take ownership of BAU Datacom activities transferred from the existing team.
  • Work with application, operations and infrastructure teams to maintain service stability.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on Broadcom Datacom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • A proven ability to diagnose and fix Datacom issues, not only monitor and escalate them.
  • Strong experience in backup and recovery, database administration, restoration and performance or query tuning.
  • Hands-on Datacom patching, maintenance and system programming experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal training or supervision.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work Mexico-aligned hours.

Preferred:

  • Spanish language capability, particularly for working with Spanish-speaking users and team members.
  • CICS, COBOL and wider mainframe application knowledge.
  • Banking or financial services experience.
  • Db2 knowledge (advantageous, not required).
  • Experience in regulated enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on Broadcom or CA Datacom DBA experience.
  • Strong IBM z/OS and JCL knowledge.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale production Datacom environments.

title: Contract Role - DevSecOps / AWS Platform Engineer
description:
6-Month Contract | Potential Full-Time Opportunity | Remote (US)

Engagement: Six-month contract, approximately 40 hours per week, with potential extension or conversion to permanent employment

Location: Remote, United States, with substantial Eastern Time business-hour overlap

Start: As soon as possible

We're looking for a highly experienced, hands-on DevSecOps / AWS Platform Engineer to help strengthen and modernize our cloud infrastructure, application security, and development operations.

This engagement encompasses two major initiatives: improving our cloud and application security infrastructure and migrating business-critical legacy systems into AWS.

You'll work closely with our engineering and technology leadership teams, with significant autonomy to recommend solutions, make technical decisions, and implement improvements.

This is not a purely advisory or architectural role. We want an engineer who enjoys designing solutions, writing code, automating infrastructure, and delivering working systems.

While initially structured as a six-month contract, we're building a long-term internal technology capability, and the right candidate may have an opportunity to transition into a permanent position.

Requirements

Cloud & Application Security

  • Evaluate and strengthen application and AWS security, including identity, authorization, data protection, and infrastructure controls.
  • Implement automated security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response capabilities.
  • Embed security practices into our development workflows without unnecessarily slowing delivery.

AWS Infrastructure & Migration

  • Lead the technical migration of legacy production workloads into WorldVia-managed AWS environments.
  • Design secure, reliable, cost-effective AWS infrastructure supporting modern applications and traditional business systems.
  • Implement infrastructure as code, backup and recovery, monitoring, and operational automation.
  • Coordinate migration testing, validation, cutover, and stabilization with internal stakeholders.

DevOps & Platform Engineering

  • Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management.
  • Integrate security scanning and automated safeguards into development workflows.
  • Establish practical infrastructure standards and reusable deployment patterns.
  • Support cloud infrastructure needs for applications incorporating generative AI and agentic workflows.
  • Document architecture, operating procedures, and technical decisions so our internal team can maintain and evolve the environment.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines.
  • Strong AWS expertise, including networking, compute, databases, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating production workloads from legacy or third-party environments into AWS, preferably including Windows-based applications.
  • Practical experience implementing application and cloud security controls.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD systems, automated security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Strong understanding of backup, disaster recovery, production monitoring, and incident response.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and collaborate with a small, fast-moving engineering team.

Especially Valuable, Preferred:

  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or other AI infrastructure.
  • Secure development practices involving AI coding tools.
  • Financial application or legacy enterprise system migrations.
  • PCI DSS or SOC 2 readiness experience.
  • Experience balancing security, reliability, infrastructure costs, and rapid product delivery.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

We're a product-driven company making a substantial investment in technology. Our engineering team is small, entrepreneurial, and actively embracing AI-assisted development.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own meaningful technical initiatives from design through production.
  • Work directly with decision-makers with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Influence the architecture and operational foundations of a growing technology platform.
  • Build automated systems and guardrails that make engineers more productive.
  • Potentially grow into a permanent role as our technology organization expands.

We value practical problem-solvers who favor thoughtful, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the initial engagement, we expect to have materially improved our security posture, modernized important AWS infrastructure, advanced or completed our priority migrations, and established more consistent and efficient deployment and operating practices.

Just as importantly, the systems and processes you build should be well-documented, maintainable, and ready for our internal team to operate.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief description of one or two relevant projects you've personally led, particularly involving AWS migration, cloud security, or DevOps automation.

We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate hands-on ownership of complex production environments and sound engineering judgment.

About WorldVia

WorldVia Travel Group is a growing travel technology and services company serving thousands of independent travel advisors, travel entrepreneurs, and corporate travel clients.

We're investing heavily in our next generation of technology, including an integrated advisor operating platform, consumer travel applications, and AIVIA, our AI-powered workspace.

Our technology strategy centers on AWS, modern software development, automation, and AI. We're building a platform designed to transform how travel professionals operate their businesses.
